title: Light Herbal Roasted Mediterranean Courgettes Gratin
description: A floral and light post-workout Mediterranean dish featuring courgettes, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian diet.
instructions: Peel the courgettes and cut them into 1/4-inch thick slices.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced courgettes, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, and chopped thyme.
Season the courgettes with salt and black pepper, and toss to coat.
In a sous-vide water bath, cook the courgettes at 180°F (82°C) for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix together the grated Pecorino cheese, breadcrumbs, and olive oil in a small bowl.
After 30 minutes, remove the courgettes from the sous-vide water bath and arrange them in a single layer in a baking dish.
Drizzle the courgettes with lemon juice and sprinkle with the Pecorino cheese mixture.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Let the gratin rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional rosemary and thyme if desired.
Garnish with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of black pepper if desired.
